name: Dirt Road Steel
old_description: I love this cross, it show me the faith and the power USA military has given us. Well crafted and beautiful color, couldn’t of asked for anything more meaningful to our heros
about:
Dirt Road Steel operates from Riverton, Wyoming, as a veteran-owned and locally operated business. The company emphasizes its American-made, handcrafted approach, though its founding year and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces hand-carved wooden flags, crosses, address signs, key holders, and split monograms, each made to order. The product line includes variations such as Old Glory and Thin Line flags, and crosses like the Old Glory Wooden Cross and Charred Wooden Cross. Upcoming offerings include metal art and custom apparel. All items are described as 100% handmade in the USA, with no details provided on facility size, headcount, or production volumes.

The company serves individual consumers looking for patriotic, military-themed, or religious gifts, as reflected in customer reviews mentioning purchases for veterans, active-duty family members, and holidays. No industrial or commercial client segments are identified in the available information.

Dirt Road Steel differentiates itself through its veteran ownership, commitment to domestic manufacturing, and made-to-order model with free shipping on all orders. The brand highlights the unique character of each hand-carved piece.
